responsibility: Declares GCC’s source-location, line-map, and diagnostics file-cache interfaces. It defines reserved locations such as UNKNOWN_LOCATION and BUILTINS_LOCATION, exposes global line_table/input_location state, macros and helpers for expanding locations and extracting ranges, the char_span and file_cache abstractions for source text access, and APIs for file content lookup, string-concatenation tracking, and location discrimination used throughout diagnostics and parsing.
same_name_distinction: Interface header for the input stem pair: it declares reserved locations, line-table globals, char_span/file_cache abstractions, location helpers, and source-text access APIs, while input.cc implements the backing file-cache, source-reading, and location expansion logic.
